_comment: Ratchet down only, same contract as test/frontend-baseline.json (never raise a number to make a red run green; a real optimisation lowers it, and the stage that lowers it explains why here). Pinned cycle 10, lowered cycle 11 (mission 20260903-173653-75d3): cycle 11 shipped server/wiregate.js — a per-viewer send gate on both tick lanes (distance-tiered rate limiting + identical-row suppression behind a WIRE_MAX_STALE_MS=15000 heartbeat; see server/wiregate.js's own comment for the tuning rationale and test/wiregate.test.js for the pinned semantics). bytesPerClientPerSec_default is measured by `node test/wire-bench.js` (default mode: 8 guest clients, 5s counting window, deterministic lattice, no Math.random anywhere) against a real server/server.js child booted via test/server-stub.js. Five consecutive post-wiregate runs on this box measured 736.7, 812.93, 837.43, 767.33, 747.2 (min 736.7, max 837.43, spread ~12.9% around a ~780 mean) — wider spread than cycle 10's pre-wiregate 5.6%, because at this short a window (5s, 8 clients spread across a wide lattice) the gate's own tier/hold timers interact with the same FAST_MS/TICK_MS frame-count quantisation cycle 10 already documented; still not flakiness, same underlying cause, just amplified by the new suppression logic. Pin lowered 900 -> 850 (a few % above the new observed max of 837.43, same margin methodology as cycle 10) with wire-bench.js's own assertion tolerance still at 20% (measured <= pin*1.20 = 1020). The N=60 numbers (`node test/wire-bench.js --clients 60 --secs 10[--parked]`, STATE.md §6) are NOT pinned here for the same reason as cycle 10 (too slow to run as a hard gate on this box) but ARE this cycle's actual P-E acceptance evidence. Cycle 10 baseline (pre-wiregate, for comparison): moving 2638.06/2613.07/2562.79 (~2605 mean), parked 2485.81, unchangedRowShare 0.19-0.23 moving / 0.92 parked. Cycle 11 after (post-wiregate), three runs each: moving 1611.47, 1611.52, 1615.94 (~1613 mean, -38.1% vs cycle-10 mean, -38.8% vs this cycle's own pre-change run of 2635.63) and unchangedRowShare fell to ~0.30 (suppression is working, most of the remaining share is the fast lane's now-legitimate near-tier resends); parked 179.72, 131.46, 145.38 (~152 mean, -93.9% vs cycle-10 mean) with unchangedRowShare ~0.36-0.46 (down from 0.92 -- most of the formerly-wasted identical parked rows are now suppressed after the 3s hold window). The stretch bar (P-E closes-when, <= 0.6x the moving baseline = ~1563-1581 depending which baseline mean you use) was NOT reached: 1613 mean is ~2-3% above it. See STATE.md P-E row and the cycle-11 implementer report for why (fast-lane near-tier resends of GPS-quantised-but-technically-changed rows are the main remaining cost) and T2.7 as the next lever.
